Accelerock.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Accelerock.descZh: 迅速撞向對手進行攻擊。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

Acid Spray.descEn: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
Acid Spray.descZh: 噴出能溶化對手的液體進行攻擊。 可大幅降低對手的特防。

Acrobatics.descEn: Has double power if the user has no held item.
Acrobatics.descZh: 輕巧地攻擊對手。 自己沒有攜帶道具時， 能給予對手較大的傷害。

Aerial Ace.descZh: 以敏捷的動作 戲弄對手後進行切斬。 攻擊必定會命中。

Air Cutter.descEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
Air Cutter.descZh: 用鋒利的風刃 斬切對手進行攻擊。 容易擊中要害。

Air Slash.descEn: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
Air Slash.descZh: 用連天空也能劈開的 空氣之刃進行攻擊。 有時會使對手畏縮。

Alluring Voice.descEn: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

Ancient Power.descEn: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.
Ancient Power.descZh: 用原始之力進行攻擊。 有時會提高 自己的所有能力。

Apple Acid.descEn: Lower the targets Special Defense by 1 stage.
Apple Acid.descZh: 使用從酸蘋果提煉出的 酸性液體進行攻擊。 可降低對手的特防。

Aqua Cutter.descEn: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

Aqua Jet.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Aqua Jet.descZh: 以迅雷不及掩耳之勢衝撞對手。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

Aqua Step.descEn: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

Armor Cannon.descEn: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

Assurance.descEn: Power is doubled if the target has already received damage this turn.
Assurance.descZh: 如果此回合內對手 已受到傷害， 招式威力會變成２倍。

Aura Sphere.descZh: 將來自體內深處的波導之力 擊向對手。 攻擊必定會命中。

Aura Wheel.descEn: Raises the user's Speed by 1 stage. In Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. In Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type.
Aura Wheel.descZh: 用儲存在頰囊中的能量進行攻擊， 並提高自己的速度。招式屬性 會隨著莫魯貝可的樣子而改變。

Avalanche.descEn: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.
Avalanche.descZh: 如果受到對手的招式攻擊， 給予該對手的招式威力就會變成２倍。

Barb Barrage.descEn: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

Beak Blast.descEn: Inflicts a burn on any Pokémon that makes contact before the attack.
Beak Blast.descZh: 先加熱鳥嘴後再進行攻擊。 若對手在加熱時觸碰的話， 就會灼傷。

Bite.descEn: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
Bite.descZh: 用尖銳的牙齒 咬住對手進行攻擊。 有時會使對手畏縮。

Bitter Blade.descEn: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

Bitter Malice.descEn: The user attacks its target with spine-chilling resentment. This may also leave the target with frostbite. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

Blaze Kick.descEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to burn the target.
Blaze Kick.descZh: 有時會讓受到攻擊的對手 陷入灼傷狀態。 且容易擊中要害。

Blizzard.descEn: Has a chance to freeze the target.
Blizzard.descZh: 將猛烈的暴風雪 吹向對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入冰凍狀態。

Body Press.descEn: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.
Body Press.descZh: 用身體撞向對手進行攻擊。 自己的防禦越高， 給予對手的傷害越大。

Body Slam.descEn: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
Body Slam.descZh: 用整個身體 壓住對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

Boomburst.descZh: 利用震耳欲聾的爆炸聲 所產生的破壞力， 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。

Brave Bird.descEn: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
Brave Bird.descZh: 收起翅膀， 低空飛行突擊對手。 自己也會受到不小的傷害。

Breaking Swipe.descEn: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
Breaking Swipe.descZh: 激烈地甩動強韌 的尾巴攻擊對手， 降低對手的攻擊。

Brick Break.descZh: 猛烈地揮下手刀 攻擊對手。還可以破壞 光牆和反射壁等。

Brutal Swing.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Brutal Swing.descZh: 用自己的身體狂舞揮打， 給予對手傷害。

Bug Bite.descEn: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
Bug Bite.descZh: 叮咬對手進行攻擊。 可以吃下對手攜帶的樹果， 並獲得樹果的效果。

Bug Buzz.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Bug Buzz.descZh: 利用振動產生出的音波進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的特防。

Bullet Punch.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Bullet Punch.descZh: 向對手連續揮出如子彈般 快速且堅硬的拳頭。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

Bullet Seed.descZh: 向對手猛烈地 發射種子進行攻擊。 連續攻擊２～５次。

Burn Up.descEn: Removes the user’s Fire type after inflicting damage.
Burn Up.descZh: 燃盡全身的火焰， 給予對手巨大的傷害。 自己的火屬性將會消失。

Burning Jealousy.descEn: Burns the target if it had a state stage raise this turn.
Burning Jealousy.descZh: 用嫉妒的能量攻擊對手。 讓此回合內能力提高的 寶可夢陷入灼傷狀態。

Ceaseless Edge.descEn: The user slashes its shell blade at the target, aiming to land a critical hit. Shell splinters left behind by this attack will continue to damage the target for several turns.

Charge Beam.descEn: Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.
Charge Beam.descZh: 向對手發射電擊光束。 有時會因電流蓄積， 提高自己的特攻。

Chilling Water.descEn: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

Circle Throw.descEn: Ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
Circle Throw.descZh: 摔飛對手， 強制讓後備寶可夢上場。 對手為野生寶可夢時，戰鬥將直接結束。

Clanging Scales.descEn: Lowers the user’s Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
Clanging Scales.descZh: 摩擦全身鱗片， 發出響亮的聲音並進行攻擊。 攻擊後自己的防禦會降低。

Close Combat.descEn: Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
Close Combat.descZh: 反守為攻，近身突擊對手。 自己的防禦和特防會降低。

Comeuppance.descEn: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

Covet.descZh: 一邊可愛地撒嬌， 一邊靠近對手， 奪取對手攜帶的道具。

Cross Chop.descEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
Cross Chop.descZh: 用左右手刀 劈打對手進行攻擊。 容易擊中要害。

Cross Poison.descEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.
Cross Poison.descZh: 用毒刃劈開對手。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態， 也容易擊中要害。

Crunch.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
Crunch.descZh: 用尖銳的牙齒咬碎對手進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的防禦。

Dark Pulse.descEn: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
Dark Pulse.descZh: 從身體散發出 充滿惡意的恐怖氣場。 有時會使對手畏縮。

Darkest Lariat.descZh: 旋轉雙臂並打向對手。 可不顧對手的能力變化 給予傷害。

Dazzling Gleam.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Dazzling Gleam.descZh: 發出強烈的閃光， 給予對手傷害。

Dig.descEn: User digs underground, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
Dig.descZh: 使用後的第１回合潛入地底， 並於第２回合攻擊對手。

Dire Claw.descEn: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws, aiming to land a critical hit. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or drowsy.

Discharge.descEn: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
Discharge.descZh: 用耀眼的電流 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

Double Shock.descEn: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.

Double-Edge.descEn: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
Double-Edge.descZh: 捨身衝撞對手進行攻擊。 自己也會受到不小的傷害。

Draco Meteor.descEn: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
Draco Meteor.descZh: 讓隕石從空中落下以攻擊對手。 使用後因為反作用力， 自己的特攻會大幅降低。

Dragon Claw.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Dragon Claw.descZh: 用尖銳的巨爪 撕裂對手進行攻擊。

Dragon Darts.descEn: Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice.
Dragon Darts.descZh: 讓多龍梅西亞進行２次攻擊。 當對手場上有２隻寶可夢時， 則向牠們各進行１次攻擊。

Dragon Pulse.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Dragon Pulse.descZh: 從張大的口中 發射衝擊波攻擊對手。

Dragon Rush.descEn: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
Dragon Rush.descZh: 釋放出駭人的殺氣， 威嚇並撞擊對手。 有時會使對手畏縮。

Dragon Tail.descEn: Ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
Dragon Tail.descZh: 彈飛對手， 強制讓後備寶可夢上場。 對手為野生寶可夢時，戰鬥將直接結束。

Drain Punch.descEn: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
Drain Punch.descZh: 從拳頭吸取對手的力量。 可以回復給予對手 傷害的一半ＨＰ。

Draining Kiss.descEn: Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.
Draining Kiss.descZh: 親吻對手來吸取對手的ＨＰ。 可以回復給予對手 傷害的一半以上的ＨＰ。

Drill Peck.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Drill Peck.descZh: 一邊旋轉，一邊將尖喙 刺進對手進行攻擊。

Drill Run.descEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
Drill Run.descZh: 像鑽頭一樣旋轉身體， 猛烈地撞擊對手。 容易擊中要害。

Drum Beating.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
Drum Beating.descZh: 用打鼓來控制 鼓的根部進行攻擊， 進而降低對手的速度。

Dual Wingbeat.descZh: 用翅膀撞向對手進行攻擊。 連續２次給予傷害。

Dynamic Punch.descEn: Has a chance to confuse the target.
Dynamic Punch.descZh: 使出渾身力量出拳進行攻擊。 必定會使對手混亂。

Earth Power.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Earth Power.descZh: 向對手腳下 釋放出大地之力。 有時會降低對手的特防。

Earthquake.descEn: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.
Earthquake.descZh: 用地震的衝擊， 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。

Electro Shot.descEn: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

Electroweb.descEn: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
Electroweb.descZh: 用電網捉住對手進行攻擊。 可降低對手的速度。

Energy Ball.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Energy Ball.descZh: 發射從大自然匯聚而來的生命力量。 有時會降低對手的特防。

Eruption.descEn: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
Eruption.descZh: 爆發怒火攻擊對手。 自己的ＨＰ越少， 招式的威力越小。

Expanding Force.descEn: If Psychic Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power incrased by 50%.
Expanding Force.descZh: 用精神力量攻擊對手。 在精神場地時，威力會提高， 能給予所有對手傷害。

Explosion.descZh: 引起大爆炸， 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 使用後自己會陷入瀕死。

Extrasensory.descEn: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
Extrasensory.descZh: 發送看不見的 神奇力量進行攻擊。 有時會使對手畏縮。

Extreme Speed.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Extreme Speed.descZh: 以迅雷不及掩耳之勢 猛撞向對手進行攻擊。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

Fake Out.descEn: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle. Causes the target to flinch.
Fake Out.descZh: 利用先制攻擊使對手畏縮。 要在上場後立即使用才會成功。

Feint.descZh: 能夠攻擊使用了 守住或看穿的對手。 並解除對手的防守效果。

Fell Stinger.descEn: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages if it KOs the target.
Fell Stinger.descZh: 使用此招式打倒對手時， 自己的攻擊會極大幅提高。

Fickle Beam.descEn: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.

Fiery Dance.descEn: Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.
Fiery Dance.descZh: 讓火焰圍繞全身後， 振翅攻擊對手。 有時會提高自己的特攻。

Fire Blast.descEn: Has a chance to burn the target.
Fire Blast.descZh: 用大字形狀的火焰燒盡對手。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

Fire Fang.descEn: Has a chance to burn the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
Fire Fang.descZh: 用纏繞火焰的牙齒咬住對手。 有時會讓對手畏縮 或陷入灼傷狀態。

Fire Punch.descEn: Has a chance to burn the target.
Fire Punch.descZh: 用帶有火焰的拳頭 攻擊對手。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

Fire Spin.descEn: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
Fire Spin.descZh: 將對手困在 熊熊燃燒的火焰旋渦中， 在４～５回合內進行攻擊。

First Impression.descEn: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle.
First Impression.descZh: 招式的威力雖高， 但只有在出場戰鬥時， 立刻使出才能成功。

Flame Charge.descEn: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Speed by one stage.
Flame Charge.descZh: 讓火焰圍繞全身後攻擊對手。 同時蓄積力量來提高自己的速度。

Flamethrower.descEn: Has a chance to burn the target.
Flamethrower.descZh: 向對手發射 強烈火焰進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

Flare Blitz.descEn: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target.
Flare Blitz.descZh: 將火焰圍繞全身後猛撞對手。 自己也會受到不小的傷害。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

Flash Cannon.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Flash Cannon.descZh: 將身體的光芒 聚集在一個點後釋放出去。 有時會降低對手的特防。

Flip Turn.descEn: User must switch out after attacking.
Flip Turn.descZh: 攻擊後迅速返回， 和後備寶可夢進行替換。

Flower Trick.descEn: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

Fly.descEn: User flies high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
Fly.descZh: 使用後的第１回合飛上天空， 並於第２回合攻擊對手。

Focus Blast.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Focus Blast.descZh: 提高氣勢， 釋放全身所有力量。 有時會降低對手的特防。

Foul Play.descEn: Calculates damage with the target’s attacking stat.
Foul Play.descZh: 利用對手的力量進行攻擊。 對手的攻擊越高， 給予對手的傷害越大。

Freeze-Dry.descZh: 急速冷凍對手， 有時會讓對手陷入冰凍狀態。 對水屬性寶可夢也是效果絕佳。

Frost Breath.descZh: 將冰冷的氣息 吹向對手進行攻擊。 必定會擊中要害。

Future Sight.descEn: Hits the target two turns later.
Future Sight.descZh: 使用招式的２回合後， 向對手發送一團念力進行攻擊。

Giga Drain.descEn: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
Giga Drain.descZh: 吸取對手的養分進行攻擊。 可以回復給予對手 傷害的一半ＨＰ。

Giga Impact.descEn: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
Giga Impact.descZh: 使出全身上下所有力量突擊對手。 下一回合自己將無法動彈。

Gigaton Hammer.descEn: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.

Glaive Rush.descEn: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.

Grassy Glide.descEn: If Grassy Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its priority increased by 1.
Grassy Glide.descZh: 在地面上滑行般地攻擊對手。 在青草場地時， 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

Grav Apple.descEn: Lower the targets Defense by 1 stage. Damage is increased by 50% during Gravitys effect.
Grav Apple.descZh: 讓蘋果從高處落下， 給予對手傷害。 可降低對手的防禦。

Gunk Shot.descEn: Has a chance to poison the target.
Gunk Shot.descZh: 將骯髒的垃圾 丟向對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

Hammer Arm.descEn: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.
Hammer Arm.descZh: 揮出強力而沉重的拳頭， 給予對手傷害。 自己的速度會降低。

Head Smash.descEn: User receives 1/2 the damage inflicted in recoil.
Head Smash.descZh: 使出渾身力量， 捨身向對手進行頭錘攻擊。 自己也會受到非常大的傷害。

Headlong Rush.descEn: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s defensive stats.

Heat Wave.descEn: Has a chance to burn the target.
Heat Wave.descZh: 將炎熱的氣息 吹向對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

Hex.descEn: Has double power if the target has a major status ailment.
Hex.descZh: 接二連三地向對手進行攻擊。 攻擊陷入異常狀態的對手時， 能給予較大的傷害。

High Horsepower.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
High Horsepower.descZh: 使出全身力量， 猛攻對手。

High Jump Kick.descEn: If the user misses, it takes half the damage it would have inflicted in recoil.
High Jump Kick.descZh: 跳起後用膝蓋踢擊對手。 沒踢中對手時自己會受到傷害。

Horn Leech.descEn: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
Horn Leech.descZh: 將角刺進對手，吸取養分。 可以回復給予對手 傷害的一半ＨＰ。

Hurricane.descEn: Has a chance to confuse the target.
Hurricane.descZh: 用強烈的風席捲 對手進行攻擊。 有時會使對手混亂。

Hydro Cannon.descEn: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
Hydro Cannon.descZh: 向對手發射水炮進行攻擊。 下一回合自己將無法動彈。

Hydro Pump.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Hydro Pump.descZh: 向對手猛烈地噴射 大量水流進行攻擊。

Hyper Beam.descEn: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
Hyper Beam.descZh: 向對手發射 強烈的光線進行攻擊。 下一回合自己將無法動彈。

Hyper Voice.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Hyper Voice.descZh: 製造出震耳欲聾的 巨大聲波攻擊對手。

Ice Beam.descEn: Has a chance to freeze the target.
Ice Beam.descZh: 向對手發射 冰凍光束進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入冰凍狀態。

Ice Fang.descEn: Has a chance to freeze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
Ice Fang.descZh: 用帶有寒氣的牙齒咬住對手。 有時會讓對手畏縮 或陷入冰凍狀態。

Ice Hammer.descEn: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.
Ice Hammer.descZh: 揮舞強力而沉重的拳頭， 給予對手傷害。 自己的速度會降低。

Ice Punch.descEn: Has a chance to freeze the target.
Ice Punch.descZh: 用帶有寒氣的拳頭 攻擊對手。 有時會讓對手陷入冰凍狀態。

Ice Shard.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Ice Shard.descZh: 將瞬間製造出的冰塊 快速地扔向對手。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

Ice Spinner.descEn: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

Icicle Crash.descEn: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
Icicle Crash.descZh: 將巨大冰柱猛烈地 砸向對手進行攻擊。 有時會使對手畏縮。

Icicle Spear.descZh: 向對手發射 尖銳的冰柱進行攻擊。 可連續攻擊２～５次。

Icy Wind.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
Icy Wind.descZh: 將冰冷的寒氣 吹向對手進行攻擊。 可降低對手的速度。

Infernal Parade.descEn: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

Infestation.descEn: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
Infestation.descZh: 在４～５回合內 死纏爛打地進行攻擊。 在此期間對手將無法逃走。

Iron Head.descEn: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
Iron Head.descZh: 用如同鋼鐵般 堅硬的頭部進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手畏縮。

Iron Tail.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
Iron Tail.descZh: 將堅硬的尾巴 甩向對手進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的防禦。

Jaw Lock.descEn: Prevents you and the target from switching out.
Jaw Lock.descZh: 使攻擊對象及自己在陷入瀕死前 都無法進行替換。當兩隻寶可夢 其中一方退場時，效果就會消失。

Jet Punch.descEn: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

Knock Off.descZh: 拍落對手的持有物， 讓對手在戰鬥結束前都無法使用。 對手有攜帶物品時，傷害會增加。

Kowtow Cleave.descEn: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

Lash Out.descEn: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.
Lash Out.descZh: 將惱怒砸向對手進行攻擊。 如果此回合已被降低能力， 招式威力就會變成２倍。

Last Resort.descEn: Can only be used after all of the user’s other moves have been used.
Last Resort.descZh: 在戰鬥中將其他已學會的招式 全部使用過後， 才能夠使出的珍藏招式。

Last Respects.descEn: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.

Lava Plume.descEn: Has a chance to burn the target.
Lava Plume.descZh: 用熊熊烈火 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

Leaf Blade.descEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
Leaf Blade.descZh: 如用劍般操控葉子 切斬對手進行攻擊。 容易擊中要害。

Leaf Storm.descEn: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
Leaf Storm.descZh: 用尖銳的葉子捲起風暴向對手進行攻擊。 使用後因為反作用力， 自己的特攻會大幅降低。

Leech Life.descEn: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
Leech Life.descZh: 吸取對手的血液進行攻擊。 可以回復給予對手 傷害的一半ＨＰ。

Light of Ruin.descEn: User receives 1/2 the damage inflicted in recoil.
Light of Ruin.descZh: 借用永恆之花的力量， 發射出強力光線。 自己也會受到不小的傷害。

Liquidation.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
Liquidation.descZh: 用水之力量撞向對手進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的防禦。

Low Sweep.descEn: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
Low Sweep.descZh: 瞄準對手的腳， 以敏捷的動作進行攻擊。 可降低對手的速度。

Lumina Crash.descEn: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

Lunge.descEn: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
Lunge.descZh: 全力猛撲對手進行攻擊。 進而降低對手的攻擊。

Mach Punch.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Mach Punch.descZh: 以迅雷不及掩耳之勢出拳。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

Make It Rain.descEn: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.

Matcha Gotcha.descEn: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

Megahorn.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Megahorn.descZh: 用堅硬且華麗的角狠狠地 刺進對手進行攻擊。

Meteor Assault.descEn: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
Meteor Assault.descZh: 揮舞粗壯的莖進行攻擊。 但同時自己也會站不穩， 下一回合將無法動彈。

Meteor Mash.descEn: Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack by one stage.
Meteor Mash.descZh: 使出如同彗星般的拳頭攻擊對手。 有時會提高自己的攻擊。

Misty Explosion.descEn: If Misty Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has its power increased by 50%.
Misty Explosion.descZh: 對自己周圍的所有寶可夢進行攻擊， 但使出後，自己會陷入瀕死。 在薄霧場地時，招式威力會提高。

Moonblast.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
Moonblast.descZh: 借用月亮的力量攻擊對手。 有時會降低對手的特攻。

Mortal Spin.descEn: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

Mountain Gale.descEn: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage.

Mud Shot.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
Mud Shot.descZh: 向對手投擲 泥塊進行攻擊。 同時降低對手的速度。

Muddy Water.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
Muddy Water.descZh: 用渾濁的污水攻擊對手。 有時會降低對手的命中率。

Mystical Fire.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
Mystical Fire.descZh: 從口中吐出特別灼熱的 火焰進行攻擊。 可降低對手的特攻。

Night Daze.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
Night Daze.descZh: 放出黑暗的衝擊波攻擊對手。 有時會降低對手的命中率。

Night Slash.descEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
Night Slash.descZh: 抓住瞬間的空隙 斬切對手。 容易擊中要害。

Nuzzle.descEn: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
Nuzzle.descZh: 用帶電的臉頰 磨蹭對手進行攻擊。 能讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

Outrage.descEn: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
Outrage.descZh: 在２～３回合內 瘋狂亂打對手進行攻擊。 大鬧一番後自己會陷入混亂。

Overdrive.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Overdrive.descZh: 彈奏吉他和貝斯， 用發出巨響的激烈震動 攻擊對手。

Overheat.descEn: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
Overheat.descZh: 釋放全部能量攻擊對手。 使用後因為反作用力， 自己的特攻會大幅降低。

Parabolic Charge.descEn: Heals the user for half the total damage dealt to all targets.
Parabolic Charge.descZh: 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 可以回復給予傷害的一半ＨＰ。

Payback.descEn: Power is doubled if the target has already moved this turn.
Payback.descZh: 累積力量進行攻擊。 若在對手之後進行攻擊， 招式的威力會變成２倍。

Phantom Force.descEn: User vanishes, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn. Hits through Protect and Detect.
Phantom Force.descZh: 使用後的第１回合消失到某處， 並於第２回合攻擊對手。 可不顧對手的守護進行攻擊。

Pin Missile.descZh: 向對手發射 銳利的針進行攻擊。 可連續攻擊２～５次。

Play Rough.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.
Play Rough.descZh: 在和對手嬉鬧的同時進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的攻擊。

Poison Jab.descEn: Has a chance to poison the target.
Poison Jab.descZh: 以帶有毒性的觸手或手臂刺進對手。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

Pollen Puff.descEn: Damages opponents, but heals allies for 50% of their max HP.
Pollen Puff.descZh: 對敵人使用時，用會爆炸的花粉團來攻擊。 對我方同伴使用時， 則給予有回復效果的花粉團。

Poltergeist.descEn: Fails if the target has no held item.
Poltergeist.descZh: 操控對手的持有物進行攻擊。 對手沒有攜帶道具時， 則會失敗。

Population Bomb.descEn: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.

Pounce.descEn: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

Power Gem.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Power Gem.descZh: 發射如寶石般 閃耀的光芒攻擊對手。

Power Trip.descEn: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.
Power Trip.descZh: 耀武揚威地攻擊對手， 自己的能力提高得越多， 威力就越大。

Power Whip.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Power Whip.descZh: 激烈地揮舞藤蔓或觸手 向對手進行攻擊。

Psychic.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Psychic.descZh: 向對手發送 強大的念力進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的特防。

Psychic Fangs.descZh: 利用精神力量咬住對手進行攻擊。 並可破壞光牆和反射壁等。

Psychic Noise.descEn: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

Psycho Cut.descEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
Psycho Cut.descZh: 用實體化的 精神利刃斬向對手。 容易擊中要害。

Psyshield Bash.descEn: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This may also raise the user’s defensive stats.

Psyshock.descEn: Inflicts damage based on the target’s Defense, not Special Defense.
Psyshock.descZh: 將神奇的念力波實體化後攻擊對手。 給予對手物理傷害。

Pyro Ball.descEn: Has a chance to burn the target.
Pyro Ball.descZh: 燃燒小石子， 形成火球攻擊對手。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

Quick Attack.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Quick Attack.descZh: 以迅雷不及掩耳之勢 撲向對手。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

Rage Fist.descEn: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.

Raging Bull.descEn: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

Rapid Spin.descEn: Frees the user from binding moves, removes Leech Seed, and blows away Spikes.
Rapid Spin.descZh: 利用旋轉來攻擊對手。 也可以擺脫綁緊、緊束， 以及解除寄生種子和撒菱等招式。

Razor Shell.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
Razor Shell.descZh: 用鋒利的貝殼斬切 對手進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的防禦。

Rising Voltage.descEn: If Electric Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its power doubled.
Rising Voltage.descZh: 用從地面升騰的電擊攻擊。 當對手在電氣場地時， 招式威力會變成２倍。

Rock Blast.descZh: 向對手發射 堅硬的岩石進行攻擊。 連續攻擊２～５次。

Rock Slide.descEn: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
Rock Slide.descZh: 將大岩石 猛烈地砸向對手進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手畏縮。

Rock Tomb.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
Rock Tomb.descZh: 投擲岩石進行攻擊。 封住對手的行動， 進而降低其速度。

Rock Wrecker.descEn: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
Rock Wrecker.descZh: 向對手發射 巨大的岩石進行攻擊。 下一回合自己將無法動彈。

Round.descEn: Has double power if it’s used more than once per turn.
Round.descZh: 用歌聲攻擊對手。 大家一起輪唱便可以接連使出， 威力也會提高。

Sacred Sword.descZh: 用長角斬切對手進行攻擊。 可不顧對手的能力變化 給予傷害。

Salt Cure.descEn: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.

Sand Tomb.descEn: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
Sand Tomb.descZh: 將對手困在 鋪天蓋地的沙暴中， 在４～５回合內進行攻擊。

Scald.descEn: Has a chance to burn the target.
Scald.descZh: 向對手噴射 滾燙的熱水進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

Scale Shot.descEn: Boosts the user’s Speed and lowers their Defense by one stage after inflicting damage two to five times in a row.
Scale Shot.descZh: 射出鱗片進行攻擊。 可連續攻擊２～５次。 速度會提高但防禦會降低。

Scorching Sands.descEn: Has a chance to burn the target.
Scorching Sands.descZh: 向對手投灑熾熱的沙子進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

Seed Bomb.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Seed Bomb.descZh: 從上方砸下外殼堅硬的 大種子，攻擊對手。

Self-Destruct.descZh: 引起爆炸， 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 使用後自己會陷入瀕死。

Shadow Ball.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
Shadow Ball.descZh: 投擲一團黑影進行攻擊。 有時會降低對手的特防。

Shadow Claw.descEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
Shadow Claw.descZh: 用黑影化成的銳利爪子 撕裂對手。 容易擊中要害。

Shadow Sneak.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Shadow Sneak.descZh: 伸長自己的影子， 從對手的背後進行攻擊。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

Shell Side Arm.descEn: Has a chance to poison the target. This switches categories between physical and special, depending on which would deal more damage to the target.
Shell Side Arm.descZh: 用物理攻擊和特殊攻擊中 能夠給予更大傷害的能力進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

Skitter Smack.descEn: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
Skitter Smack.descZh: 從對手背後爬近後進行攻擊。 會降低對手的特攻。

Slash.descEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
Slash.descZh: 用爪子或鐮刀等 劈開對手進行攻擊。 容易擊中要害。

Sludge Bomb.descEn: Has a chance to poison the target.
Sludge Bomb.descZh: 向對手投擲污泥進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

Sludge Wave.descEn: Has a chance to poison the target.
Sludge Wave.descZh: 用污泥波攻擊 自己周圍所有的寶可夢。 有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

Smack Down.descEn: Removes any immunity to Ground damage.
Smack Down.descZh: 向空中的對手投擲石頭或炮彈等物體 進行攻擊。對手會被擊落，掉到地面。

Snap Trap.descEn: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
Snap Trap.descZh: 用捕獸夾， 在４～５回合內 夾住對手進行攻擊。

Snarl.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
Snarl.descZh: 沒完沒了地向對手大聲咆哮， 降低對手的特攻。

Snipe Shot.descEn: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.
Snipe Shot.descZh: 能不受具有吸引對手招式 效果的特性或招式影響， 向選定的對手進行攻擊。

Solar Beam.descEn: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
Solar Beam.descZh: 使用後的第１回合吸收大量日光， 並於第２回合發射光束進行攻擊。

Solar Blade.descEn: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
Solar Blade.descZh: 第１回合收集滿滿的日光， 第２回合將此力量 集中在劍上並進行攻擊。

Sparkling Aria.descZh: 隨著歌聲放出許多水球。 受此招式攻擊時， 灼傷會被治癒。

Spirit Break.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
Spirit Break.descZh: 用足以讓對手一蹶不振的 氣勢進行攻擊。 可降低對手的特攻。

Spirit Shackle.descZh: 攻擊的同時， 縫住對手的影子， 使其無法逃走。

Steel Beam.descEn: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up.
Steel Beam.descZh: 將從全身匯聚起來的鋼鐵 化為光束激烈地發射出去。 自己也會受到傷害。

Steel Roller.descEn: Ends the effect of Electric, Grassy, Misty, or Psychic Terrains. Fails if no Terrain is active.
Steel Roller.descZh: 一邊破壞場地，一邊進行攻擊。 在不是特殊狀態的場地上使用， 招式就會失敗。

Stomping Tantrum.descEn: Has double power if the user’s last move failed.
Stomping Tantrum.descZh: 化悔恨為力量進行攻擊。 如果上一回合的招式沒有命中， 威力就會加倍。

Stone Axe.descEn: The user swings its stone axes at the target, aiming to land a critical hit. Stone splinters left behind by this attack continue to damage the target for several turns.

Stone Edge.descEn: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
Stone Edge.descZh: 用尖銳的岩石 刺進對手進行攻擊。 容易擊中要害。

Stored Power.descEn: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.
Stored Power.descZh: 用蓄積的力量攻擊對手。 自己的能力提高越多， 招式的威力越大。

Storm Throw.descZh: 向對手發動強烈的一擊。 一定會擊中要害。

Struggle Bug.descEn: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
Struggle Bug.descZh: 抵抗對手進行攻擊。 可降低對手的特攻。

Sucker Punch.descEn: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.
Sucker Punch.descZh: 可以搶先對手一步進行攻擊。 若對手使用的不是攻擊招式則會失敗。

Supercell Slam.descEn: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

Superpower.descEn: Lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
Superpower.descZh: 發揮驚人的力量攻擊對手。 自己的攻擊和防禦會降低。

Surf.descEn: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.
Surf.descZh: 使用大浪 攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。

Syrup Bomb.descEn: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.

Temper Flare.descEn: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

Terrain Pulse.descEn: If any terrain is active and the user is grounded, this moves power is doubled and changes type to match that terrains type.
Terrain Pulse.descZh: 藉助場地的力量進行攻擊。 視使出招式時場地狀態不同， 招式的屬性和威力會有所變化。

Thrash.descEn: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
Thrash.descZh: 在２～３回合內 瘋狂亂打對手進行攻擊。 大鬧一番後自己會陷入混亂。

Throat Chop.descEn: Prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
Throat Chop.descZh: 受到此招式攻擊的對手， 會因為地獄般的痛苦，在２回合內 無法使用會發出聲音的招式。

Thunder.descEn: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
Thunder.descZh: 向對手劈下暴雷進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

Thunder Fang.descEn: Has a chance to paralyze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
Thunder Fang.descZh: 用蓄滿電流的牙齒咬住對手。 有時會讓對手畏縮 或陷入麻痺狀態。

Thunder Punch.descEn: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
Thunder Punch.descZh: 用帶有電流的拳頭 攻擊對手。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

Thunderbolt.descEn: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
Thunderbolt.descZh: 向對手放出強力電流進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

Torch Song.descEn: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

Trailblaze.descEn: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

Triple Arrows.descEn: The user delivers an axe kick, then fires three arrows. This raises the chance of its future attacks landing critical hits and also lowers the target's defensive stats.

Triple Axel.descEn: Hits three times, increasing power by 100% with each successful hit.
Triple Axel.descZh: 連續踢對手３次進行攻擊。 每踢中一次，威力就會提高。

Trop Kick.descEn: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
Trop Kick.descZh: 向對手使出來自南國的火熱腳踢。 進而降低對手的攻擊。

Twin Beam.descEn: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

U-turn.descEn: User must switch out after attacking.
U-turn.descZh: 攻擊後迅速返回， 和後備寶可夢進行替換。

Upper Hand.descEn: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

Uproar.descEn: Forced to use this move for several turns. Pokémon cannot fall asleep in that time.
Uproar.descZh: 在３回合內 大吵大鬧攻擊對手。 在此期間誰都無法入眠。

Vacuum Wave.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
Vacuum Wave.descZh: 揮動拳頭， 捲起真空波。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

Volt Switch.descEn: User must switch out after attacking.
Volt Switch.descZh: 攻擊後迅速返回， 和後備寶可夢進行替換。

Volt Tackle.descEn: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
Volt Tackle.descZh: 用電流圍繞全身後猛撞對手。 自己也會受到不小的傷害。 有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

Water Pulse.descEn: Has a chance to confuse the target.
Water Pulse.descZh: 用水的震動攻擊對手。 有時會使對手混亂。

Water Shuriken.descZh: 射出用黏液製成的手裡劍， 連續攻擊２～５次。 必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

Water Spout.descEn: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
Water Spout.descZh: 噴起潮水進行攻擊。 自己的ＨＰ越少， 招式的威力越小。

Waterfall.descEn: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
Waterfall.descZh: 以驚人的氣勢撲向對手。 有時會讓對手畏縮。

Wave Crash.descEn: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user and raises the user’s action speed.

Weather Ball.descEn: If there be weather, this move has doubled power and the weather’s type.
Weather Ball.descZh: 招式屬性和威力會隨著 使用時天氣的不同而改變。

Whirlpool.descEn: Prevents the target from leaving battle and inflicts 1/16 its max HP in damage for 2-5 turns.
Whirlpool.descZh: 將對手困在激烈的 水流漩渦中， 在４～５回合內進行攻擊。

Wild Charge.descEn: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
Wild Charge.descZh: 讓電流圍繞全身， 衝撞對手進行攻擊。 自己也會受到少許傷害。

Wood Hammer.descEn: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
Wood Hammer.descZh: 用堅硬的軀體 撞擊對手進行攻擊。 自己也會受到不小的傷害。

X-Scissor.descEn: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
X-Scissor.descZh: 將鐮刀或爪子像剪刀般地交叉， 順勢劈開對手。

Zap Cannon.descEn: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
Zap Cannon.descZh: 發射如大炮般的 電流進行攻擊。 能讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

Zen Headbutt.descEn: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
Zen Headbutt.descZh: 將意念的力量集中在 前額進行攻擊。 有時會讓對手畏縮。

Zing Zap.descEn: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
Zing Zap.descZh: 撞向對手，並利用 強電流使其感到麻麻刺刺的。 有時會使對手畏縮。
